note: Which names a variable may take, and the line a copy of one draws. The measured cases run against a fake measurer whose width counts the units a JavaScript string counts, so a label holding a character outside the basic plane measures two units wide in both engines rather than one. The cases naming no measurer are the headless ones, where a measured slot reports a measurement error rather than a guessed size.
